title.narrative: COVID-19: Vaccine Support Project under the Asia Pacific Vaccine Access Facility

description.narrative: The project will provide the Government of Afghanistan with urgently needed and flexible financing for coronavirus disease (COVID-19) vaccine procurement and logistics, and capacity strengthening activities through the APVAX. Afghanistan has met all APVAX access criteria. The project investment component under the APVAX will be utilized. The project will support the implementation of the National Plan for COVID-19 Vaccination in Afghanistan (NPCVA) in line with the fragile and conflict-affected situations (FCAS) approach and Strategy 2030 of the Asian Development Bank (ADB).

Output: COVID-19 vaccines procured and delivered to designated points Indicator: At least 6 million doses of COVID-19 vaccine (with syringes and safety boxes) delivered to designated delivery points Progress/Status: The initial discussions to engage UNICEF / GAVI have progressed well until mid AUG 2021 but not completed due to the government collapse on 15 AUG 2021. The contract for domestic transport of Covid-19 vaccines and capacity building was also ready for singing in AUG 2021. As per approved approach paper “Afghanistan 2021 Situation: Proposed Actions and Next Steps” ADB has paused its operations. Output: Vaccine program implementation capacity strengthened Indicator: At least five regional or provincial offices of the MOPH have strengthened capacity to effectively oversee procurement, delivery, and management of vaccines in a gender-sensitive way, with at least 30% women trainees Progress/Status: This will be delayed following the government collapse in mid AUG 2021 where all activities were stopped. As per approved approach paper “Afghanistan 2021 Situation: Proposed Actions and Next Steps” ADB has paused its operations. Data Source: Measurement of the indicator will include (i) the number of health workers (male and female) who attended the trainings on gender sensitivity, and (ii) the number of trainings conducted that included sessions on gender sensitivity Actual value:
